title: EMA Ribbon Trend
author: example_author
synthetic_note: Example on synthetic bars. Every number is computed on these bars, but this is not a market.
rule: Long on the "ribbon turns bullish" signal (EMA 8 > 21 > 55 on a closed bar), filled at the next bar's open; exit on "ribbon turns bearish" (8 < 21 < 55), at the next bar's open. No shorts.
